description:
Update a credit by id.

Rules:
- Partial update: pass the id plus ONLY the fields to change; everything you leave out keeps its stored value. Lists you do send (steps, tiers, entitlements) are the complete new list. Active state isn't an update field — use the archive / unarchive tools.
- Send `models` to re-price from a new mixer; leave it out to keep the current price (a new marginPercent is applied on top of the stored base price).
- Changing `agentKey` re-points which runtime signals map here — do it deliberately.

agentKey.description: Lowercased stable key you report credit usage against (sent as `agentKey` when recording usage). The credit's durable identity — chars [a-z0-9._-]; a rename never changes it.

marginPercent.description: Markup over the computed base cost, as a percent (100 = double the base = pricePerCredit; negative discounts, down to -100 = free).

models.description: Model mixer that GROUNDS the price — one or more enabled catalog models with avg tokens + input/output/cache split. The tool reads live prices and computes the base cost; never type a raw price.

avgTokens.description: Average TOTAL tokens per credit / per step (input + output + cache combined).

cachePct.description: Percent that are cache-READ tokens (whole number). Default 0.

cacheWritePct.description: Percent that are cache-WRITE tokens (whole number). Default 0. Only for a model that has a cache-write price (cacheWritePrice in clocknext_list_models); must be 0 otherwise.

inputPct.description: Percent of avgTokens that are input tokens (whole number).

model.description: Enabled catalog model id from clocknext_list_models (e.g. 'gpt-4o'). Grounds the price in that model's live per-1M-token cost.

outputPct.description: Percent that are output tokens (whole number).
